review.reviewer: Independent WEB-03 review of linked browser artifacts and pinned inputs
review.rationale: Bind the exact Dashboard App project and diagnostic substitution file. The App-only ILLink rules replace two protobuf diagnostic text paths in Google.Protobuf 3.36.2 and preserve the binary codecs of the published ArcForges.Contracts.PublicApi 1.0.0-ci.481.1 and its matching cohort. The package versions, lockfiles, closures, SDK, profile budgets and verification tools are unchanged.
review.runtimeAssessment: Exact H-22 verification of 0f25ad7e8133a62e8c718a79721ce8007f558cb6 built, tested and published successfully. Its original check.log (20261121-142630-0f25ad7e8133-linux, SHA-256 a7f1329598423e11ae1582082df7d029b2931aee7fe80108c110627dbb6d7b7e) refused the changed App project hash before the candidate. The isolated Windows prebuilt-runtime diagnostic with the generated clients measured 62 initial requests, 4396809 bytes of WebAssembly gzip and a verified 23826432-byte profile archive. Formal candidate and browser qualification continue under their existing checks.
review.maintenance: Retain the predecessor receipt and original dependency evidence. Rebind both exact App linker input paths when their reviewed content changes and keep diagnostic presentation separate from binary codecs.
review.immutableHistory: Admitted review records are retained in Git history. A dependency change requires a new reviewed source commit and updated input-bound rationale; never amend an already accepted provenance record.

allowlist.description: Reviewed public schema digest in the CON.07 Contracts publication record: the key name contains auth, and the value is the SHA-256 of the packaged public schema (verified against the NuGet package bytes)

packsFolderRows.reason: The hosted Windows C# job (ci.yml) installs the wasm-tools workload at workload set 11.0.100 into its isolated SDK root, as the Windows verification leg requires of its SDK root, and that packs folder holds this pack at the bundled version 11.0.0, so the SDK adds no NuGet download. A local machine whose packs folder lacks 11.0.0 restores the NuGet copy and it is verified by digest there.

The Ubuntu hosted image carries no WebAssembly workload, so this row is checked there and not satisfied: the SDK adds the implicit pack as a NuGet download, restores it and the test verifies its digest. The NuGet copy is skipped only when a 11.0.0 packs copy with the marker exists locally, and in that case the SDK does not download the pack either.
